relationships.subject: luteolin
relationships.evidence_quote: Luteolin treatment could inhibit the activation of neurons, glial cells, and NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasomes in the dorsal spinal cord in the BCP mouse model.

relationships.subject: luteolin
relationships.evidence_quote: phosphorylated p-38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) in the spinal dorsal horn (SDH) was suppressed by luteolin treatment

key_findings: Luteolin ameliorated LLC-induced bone cancer pain and suppressed glial and NLRP3 activation via p38 MAPK in SDH
